name: SOCAT (Surface Ocean CO2 Atlas) v2022
model_or_instrument: Ship-based, mooring, and autonomous surface pCO2 observation platforms
resolution: Various in situ; gridded products typically 1° x 1° monthly

scales.note: SOCAT contains >30M surface pCO2 point observations, commonly aggregated into a global 1°x1° monthly gridded product spanning the 1960s through 2021.
